spec.description: Hosts de virtualização (Hyper-V): host x VMs, a partir do inventário (integrations/hypervisor) e dos contadores do Hyper-V.

spec.title: CPU do host
spec.description: CPU física do host (0 a 100%), separando o que as VMs usam do que o Windows do host usa.

spec.title: Memória do host
spec.description: Memória física: cada VM ligada, o Windows do host e o que está livre.

spec.title: Folga de memória
spec.description: Livre: memória física livre no host. Desligadas pedem: memória inicial somada das VMs desligadas. Falta: quanto faltaria para ligar todas ('cabe' = há memória suficiente).

spec.title: Armazenamento do host
spec.description: Um volume por linha. A barra mostra o ocupado; o trecho vazio é o livre. Enche em: previsão pela tendência das últimas 24h; estável = não enche em menos de 90 dias.
O F: do srv-host01 (backups) fica de fora: o ciclo diário de backup engana a previsão; ele tem alertas próprios (HYP-203/204).

spec.expr: ((min(max by (volume) ((windows_logical_disk_free_bytes{job="integrations/windows",instance="$host",volume=~"[A-Z]:"} / (-deriv(windows_logical_disk_free_bytes{job="integrations/windows",instance="$host",volume=~"[A-Z]:"}[1d]) > 0)) < 7776000) unless on (volume) windows_logical_disk_free_bytes{job="integrations/windows",instance="srv-host01",volume="F:"})) / 86400) or on () vector(-1)

spec.title: Provisionamento dos discos virtuais
spec.description: VHDX dinâmicos crescem até o tamanho máximo. Folga = livre no volume - quanto os VHDX ainda podem crescer. Negativa: se todos crescerem, o volume enche.

spec.expr: max by (volume) (windows_logical_disk_free_bytes{job="integrations/windows",instance="$host"}) and on (volume) sum by (volume) (label_replace(hypervisor_vm_disk_file_bytes{job="integrations/hypervisor",instance="$host"}, "volume", "$1", "path", "^([A-Za-z]:).*"))

spec.title: Rede do vSwitch
spec.description: Tráfego do switch virtual (todas as VMs e o host) em bits/s; Tx para baixo.
Ligadas primeiro. Clique no nome da VM para abrir a página dela. CPU = % das vCPUs da própria VM; Disputa = % do tempo esperando CPU física.

spec.expr: (max by (vm) (9 * max by (vm) (hypervisor_vm_state{job="integrations/hypervisor",instance="$host",state="running"}) + 8 * max by (vm) (hypervisor_vm_state{job="integrations/hypervisor",instance="$host",state="starting"}) + 7 * max by (vm) (hypervisor_vm_state{job="integrations/hypervisor",instance="$host",state="stopping"}) + 6 * max by (vm) (hypervisor_vm_state{job="integrations/hypervisor",instance="$host",state="paused"}) + 5 * max by (vm) (hypervisor_vm_state{job="integrations/hypervisor",instance="$host",state="saved"}) + 4 * max by (vm) (hypervisor_vm_state{job="integrations/hypervisor",instance="$host",state="other"})) + on (vm) (sum by (vm) (rate(windows_hyperv_hypervisor_virtual_processor_total_run_time_total{job="integrations/hyperv",instance="$host"}[5m])) / count by (vm) (windows_hyperv_hypervisor_virtual_processor_total_run_time_total{job="integrations/hyperv",instance="$host"}) / 10)) or max by (vm) (9 * max by (vm) (hypervisor_vm_state{job="integrations/hypervisor",instance="$host",state="running"}) + 8 * max by (vm) (hypervisor_vm_state{job="integrations/hypervisor",instance="$host",state="starting"}) + 7 * max by (vm) (hypervisor_vm_state{job="integrations/hypervisor",instance="$host",state="stopping"}) + 6 * max by (vm) (hypervisor_vm_state{job="integrations/hypervisor",instance="$host",state="paused"}) + 5 * max by (vm) (hypervisor_vm_state{job="integrations/hypervisor",instance="$host",state="saved"}) + 4 * max by (vm) (hypervisor_vm_state{job="integrations/hypervisor",instance="$host",state="other"}))

sum by (vm) ((rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_bytes_read{job="integrations/hyperv",instance="$host"}[5m]) + rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_bytes_written{job="integrations/hyperv",instance="$host"}[5m])) * on (device) group_left (vm) group by (device, vm) (hypervisor_vm_disk_info{job="integrations/hypervisor",instance="$host"}))

8 * sum by (vm) ((rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_network_adapter_received_bytes_total{job="integrations/hyperv",instance="$host"}[5m]) + rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_network_adapter_sent_bytes_total{job="integrations/hyperv",instance="$host"}[5m])) * on (adapter) group_left (vm) group by (adapter, vm) (hypervisor_vm_network_info{job="integrations/hypervisor",instance="$host"}))

label_replace(label_replace(max by (vm, guest_os, guest_host, dash) (label_replace(label_replace(hypervisor_vm_info{job="integrations/hypervisor",instance="$host",guest_kind!="unknown"}, "dash", "servers-windows", "guest_kind", "windows"), "dash", "servers-linux", "guest_kind", "linux") or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(hypervisor_vm_info{job="integrations/hypervisor",instance="$host",guest_kind="unknown"}, "instance", "$1", "guest_host", "(.*)") and on (instance) last_over_time(windows_os_info{job="integrations/windows"}[30d]), "dash", "servers-windows", "", ""), "guest_os", "Windows (último visto)", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(hypervisor_vm_info{job="integrations/hypervisor",instance="$host",guest_kind="unknown"}, "instance", "$1", "guest_host", "(.*)") and on (instance) last_over_time(node_os_info{job="integrations/unix"}[30d]), "dash", "servers-linux", "", ""), "guest_os", "Linux (último visto)", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(hypervisor_vm_info{job="integrations/hypervisor",instance="$host",guest_kind="unknown"} unless on (vm) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(hypervisor_vm_info{job="integrations/hypervisor",instance="$host",guest_kind="unknown"}, "instance", "$1", "guest_host", "(.*)") and on (instance) last_over_time(windows_os_info{job="integrations/windows"}[30d]), "dash", "servers-windows", "", ""), "guest_os", "Windows (último visto)", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(hypervisor_vm_info{job="integrations/hypervisor",instance="$host",guest_kind="unknown"}, "instance", "$1", "guest_host", "(.*)") and on (instance) last_over_time(node_os_info{job="integrations/unix"}[30d]), "dash", "servers-linux", "", ""), "guest_os", "Linux (último visto)", "", "")), "dash", "hypervisors", "", ""), "guest_os", "desconhecido", "", "")), "guest_os", "Windows Server $1", "guest_os", "Windows Server ([0-9]+) .*"), "guest_os", "Debian", "guest_os", "Debian.*")

spec.title: CPU por VM
spec.description: As 5 VMs que mais usaram CPU física (% do host).

spec.title: Disco por VM
spec.description: As 5 VMs com mais leitura + escrita.

spec.expr: topk(5, sum by (vm) ((rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_bytes_read{job="integrations/hyperv",instance="$host"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_bytes_written{job="integrations/hyperv",instance="$host"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (device) group_left (vm) group by (device, vm) (hypervisor_vm_disk_info{job="integrations/hypervisor",instance="$host"})))

spec.title: Rede por VM
spec.description: As 5 VMs com mais tráfego (Rx + Tx).

spec.expr: topk(5, 8 * sum by (vm) ((rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_network_adapter_received_bytes_total{job="integrations/hyperv",instance="$host"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_network_adapter_sent_bytes_total{job="integrations/hyperv",instance="$host"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (adapter) group_left (vm) group by (adapter, vm) (hypervisor_vm_network_info{job="integrations/hypervisor",instance="$host"})))

spec.title: VMs
spec.description: VMs do host pelo inventário (inclui desligadas). Desligadas = qualquer estado diferente de ligada (desligada, salva, pausada...).

spec.title: Eventos do Hyper-V (VMMS / Worker)
spec.description: Canais Microsoft-Windows-Hyper-V-VMMS-Admin e Worker-Admin: ligar, desligar, travar, checkpoints, movimentação. Aberto pelo link de Erros (24h), mostra só erros e críticos.

spec.expr: {job="hyperv-eventlog", host="$host"} | label_format level=`{{ if eq .level "1" }}critical{{ else if eq .level "2" }}error{{ else if eq .level "3" }}warning{{ else if eq .level "4" }}info{{ else if eq .level "5" }}debug{{ else }}{{ .level }}{{ end }}` | level=~"$nivel" | json source="source", event_id="event_id", message="message" | line_format `{{ .source }} [{{ .event_id }}]: {{ .message }}`

spec.title: Disputa por VM
spec.description: % do tempo esperando CPU física, por VM. Até 2%: folgado.

spec.title: CPU por VM (% das próprias vCPUs)
spec.description: Uso de CPU de cada VM em relação às vCPUs dela.

spec.title: Latência por disco virtual
spec.description: Latência média por operação em cada VHDX (média de 100 ns convertida).

spec.title: Fila por disco virtual
spec.description: Fila média de I/O em cada VHDX.

spec.title: Descartes no vSwitch
spec.description: Pacotes descartados por segundo no switch virtual. O normal é zero.

spec.title: Inventário de VMs
spec.description: 1 = execução concluída. Duração em segundos (limite 60 s).

spec.title: CPU do host
spec.description: CPU física do host ocupada, incluindo as VMs (contadores do hypervisor). Não usar a CPU do dashboard Windows para host Hyper-V: lá só aparece a partição raiz.

spec.title: Coleta do Hyper-V
spec.description: 1 = Alloy coletando os contadores do Hyper-V e o inventário.

spec.title: RAM
spec.description: Memória física do host em uso (VMs + Windows do host).

spec.title: Disputa
spec.description: Média, entre as VMs ligadas, do tempo em que uma vCPU ficou esperando CPU física (como o steal do Linux). Até 2%: folgado; 2 a 5%: atenção; acima de 5%: VMs sentindo falta de CPU.

spec.expr: ((time() - hypervisor_inventory_timestamp_seconds{job="integrations/hypervisor",instance="$host"}) and on () (hypervisor_inventory_success{job="integrations/hypervisor",instance="$host"} == 1)) or on () (hypervisor_inventory_success{job="integrations/hypervisor",instance="$host"} - 1) or on () vector(-2)

links.title: Visão geral
links.tooltip: Página inicial: alertas e estado de todas as áreas

spec.title: Hypervisors

spec.name: nivel
spec.label: Nível
spec.description: Regex de nível dos logs. Preenchido pelo link de Erros (24h).
